(acetyldihydrocodeine) Profile Acetyldihydrocodeine hydrochloride is an opioid derivative re- lated to dihydrocodeine (p.48). It is used as a centrally acting cough suppressant for non-productive cough (p.1547) and has been given in a usual oral daily dose of 20 to 50 mg; no more than 20 mg should be taken as a single dose.
